About TresVista & Descrial
TresVista is a global platform providing sophisticated solutions to clients combining domain expertise, technology, and human
capital. Our unique model allows clients to achieve excellence through embracing best in class AI and human capital with an offshore
resource model.
Descrial, the dedicated technology product unit, is at the forefront of innovation leveraging AI and intelligent automation to build
workflow-native solutions. Our approach goes beyond traditional product development, integrating design research, data
engineering, and applied AI to build solutions that are scalable, evidence-based, and user-centric. For experienced product leaders
and technologists.
Descrial offers the opportunity to define next-generation tools that transform how investment professionals interact with data and
make decisions. Descrial is focused on building solutions delivering smarter and faster ways to conduct diligence, analysis, and make
investment decisions.
Role Overview
As a Software Engineer on the Agentic and Assist backend team, you will build and maintain the Python-based services and APIs that
power intelligent assistance, document understanding, and agent-style workflows for Descrial's multi-tenant WOS platform. You
will work with FastAPI, PostgreSQL, async SQLAlchemy, and LLM/agent frameworks (e.g. LangGraph, LangChain ecosystem, OpenAI
APIs), and collaborate with teams owning Java/Spring services and shared infrastructure.
Roles and Responsibilities
Backend service development
Implement RESTful APIs and background/async flows using Python 3.11+, FastAPI, and Pydantic.
Contribute to data models, repositories, and multi-tenant-aware access patterns (tenant context, safe isolation).
Integrate with PostgreSQL (including async drivers), and support schema evolution (e.g. Liquibase) alongside the team.
Implement integrations with LLM providers, vector/RAG components, and internal Descrial services; handle errors, retries, and
structured logging appropriately).
Quality and testing
Write unit and integration tests using pytest, pytest-asyncio, and HTTP client mocks (e.g. respx / httpx).
Follow clean code and SOLID principles; participate in code reviews for Python services.
Apply basics of performance (efficient queries, avoiding N+1 patterns, sensible caching where introduced).
DevOps, monitoring, and cloud
Use Git and team CI/CD (e.g. Jenkins + quality gates); fix build/test failures you touch.
Deploy and operate services on Linux and AWS (containers, ECS/EKS-style patterns) with senior guidance.
Support observability: OpenTelemetry/traces, logs, and metrics aligned with Prometheus / Loki / Grafana (or equivalent stack).
AI/LLM Integration
Support prototyping and integration of AI/LLMpowered features using Python and libraries such as:
Implement prompt orchestration, RAG pipelines, and agent graphs (e.g. LangGraph, LangChain) under clear specifications.
Consume OpenAI (or similar) APIs safely (keys, timeouts, rate limits); assist with evaluation and logging of model calls.
Software Engineer - Back End
Technology Products
1. TresVista is a proud Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate on any basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, disability, marital status, or national origin.
All aspects of TresVista employment will be based on merit, competence, performance, and business needs
2. The role involves contributing to TresVista's data security practices by ensuring the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of information handled, in alignment with the ISMS policies and framework
3. The role involves contributing to TresVista's business continuity practices by supporting organizational resilience, minimizing disruption, and ensuring timely recovery of critical operations in alignment with
the BCMS policies
Prerequisites
1-2 years of experience in backend development withJava(preferably Java 11+, with awareness of Java17 features).
Handson experience with Spring Boot (REST APIs, JPA/Hibernate) and relational databases.
WorkingknowledgeofPython(e.g., scripting, utilities, orbackendservices)-required.
FamiliaritywithGit,CI/CD(Jenkins),SonarQube, andLinux.
Understandingorstronginterest inmultitenant SaaS architectures (tenant isolation, shared vs. dedicated resources).
Good to Have
ExposuretoLLM/ AItoolingsuch asLangChain,OpenAI APIs,AutoGen,CrewAI, orLangFlow(buildingorintegratingAIassisted
workflows or agents).
Strongdebugging, problemsolving, and collaboration skills.
Education
Bachelor's degree in engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience from premier Engineering institution (IIT/NIT/IIIT).
Compensation:
The compensation structure will be as per industry standardsscription

Python,FastAPI,PostgreSQL,AsyncIO,REST,LangChain,LangGraph,RAG,LLMs,Docker,AWS,SQL,Microservices,Testing,Git
